cases.sql: WITH order_category_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, c.category_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN analytics.dim_category AS c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND c.level = 2 GROUP BY o.order_id, c.category_id), order_category_refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, c.category_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded_idr FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r JOIN analytics.fact_orders AS o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN analytics.dim_category AS c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND c.level = 2 GROUP BY r.order_id, c.category_id) SELECT c.category_name AS subcategory, SUM(n.line_net_idr - COALESCE(r.refunded_idr, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_category_net AS n JOIN analytics.dim_category AS c ON c.category_id = n.category_id LEFT JOIN order_category_refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id AND r.category_id = n.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY net_revenue_idr DESC LIMIT 3
assumptions: Net revenue is grouped by product subcategory, with refunds assigned to the order date and returned item's subcategory.
cases.answer: The top subcategories by net revenue in 2025 were Smartphones (IDR 20.1B), Audio (IDR 14.8B), and Computers & Accessories (IDR 11.1B).

Nilai PO dihitung dari jumlah yang dipesan dikalikan biaya per unit.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE)) AS august_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE)) AS september_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE)) - COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE)) AS order_delta FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE)

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) AS order_date, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE)), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id), order_revenue AS (SELECT n.order_date, n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0) AS net_revenue FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id) SELECT CASE WHEN order_date >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) THEN 'calendar_q1_2026' WHEN order_date >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) THEN 'fiscal_q1_fy2026' END AS period, SUM(net_revenue) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_revenue WHERE (order_date >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE)) OR (order_date >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id

cases.sql: WITH sold AS (SELECT o.channel_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.channel_id), returned AS (SELECT o.channel_id, SUM(r.quantity) AS units_returned FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_returns AS r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.channel_id) SELECT c.channel_name AS channel_name, ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(r.units_returned, 0) AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(s.units_sold, 0), 4) AS return_rate FROM analytics.dim_channel AS c LEFT JOIN sold AS s ON s.channel_id = c.channel_id LEFT JOIN returned AS r ON r.channel_id = c.channel_id ORDER BY c.channel_name
